connector.name: Flightaware MCP
connector.registryDescription: Live flight tracking and aviation data via FlightAware AeroAPI (flights, airports, alerts).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package flightaware-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AEROAPI_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Default directory for flight-map PNGs (default: current working directory)

env.name: AEROAPI_CACHE_TTL
env.description: Seconds to cache identical live-data GET responses (default 15; 0 disables)

env.name: AEROAPI_STATIC_CACHE_TTL
env.description: Seconds to cache reference data — airports, operators, routes, ownership (default 3600; 0 disables)
